correctness.rationale: The exact first image from μZ is μ[ν(1−U)+a μ^(−(1−γ))U^γ]. For sufficiently small μ it remains at least νμ; subsequent excursion branches multiply by ν, giving T=1+max(0,ceil(log(y/μ)/log(1/ν))) and R=ν^(T−1)y/μ. Along μ_j=(aν^(j+θ))^(1/(1−γ)), the logarithm is j+θ−V+o(1), and the integer ceiling stabilizes almost surely except countably many phase boundaries. The uniform-U law yields V=v0+Exponential(rate log(1/ν)/γ), giving the exact J tail, geometric long-excursion deficit and conditional power-law density on (ν,1). An interior implicit-function threshold yields the claimed positive first correction. Independent direct orbit iterations and the exact ceiling agree for 15 instances (j=8,16,28); the return coordinate error at j=28 was below 7.1e−9. The almost-sure and expectation results follow from analytic tail bounds, not these iterates.
